name: Olympics

flag.description: A white field with five interlocking rings in the centre: blue, black and red on top, yellow and green below.
flag.symbolism: The five rings stand for the union of the five inhabited continents; Pierre de Coubertin said the six colours, white included, could reproduce every national flag of his day.

hook: Five linked rings on white, three on top and two below: blue, black and red over yellow and green.
trivia: Pierre de Coubertin designed the flag in 1913, and it was first flown at the Games in Antwerp in 1920.
At each closing ceremony the flag is handed from the host city's mayor to the mayor of the next host city.
